option_a.treatment: Boss treatment: surface Mal.4.1-Mal.4.3 as a dependent child.
option_a.requirements: Mechanically require Mal.3.13-Mal.4.3 parent plus sibling Mal.3.13-Mal.3.18 hydration on every retrieval or presentation.
option_a.evidence: Correlated samekh after MT Mal.3.18, כי הנה oracle onset, complete burning/healing contrast, and pe after MT Mal.3.21.
option_a.benefit: Preserves a real, coherent day-oracle retrieval target without denying its parent.

option_b.treatment: Canonical appeal: retain Mal.4.1-Mal.4.3 only as an internal seam and surface Mal.3.13-Mal.4.3 whole.
option_b.requirements: Expose the day-oracle title and internal coordinates for navigation, but never return it as a standalone chunk.

active_appeals.counterevidence: The paragraph markers and complete antithetical form make option A genuinely strong; the appeal does not deny the seam or literary form.
active_appeals.uncertainty: The evidence does not by itself decide whether dependent retrieval with enforced hydration is safer and more useful than whole-only retrieval, and this artifact cannot verify downstream hydration enforcement.
active_appeals.requested_reviewer: An independent human or external-AI reviewer with prophetic-literary and retrieval-system competence, able to inspect both the Hebrew discourse relation and actual hydration behavior.
active_appeals.requested_resolution: Choose option A only with demonstrated mandatory parent+sibling hydration; otherwise choose option B. Until verified, preserve the larger surface and hold the child-presentation treatment.
